Description: Identifier shared by every specimen that was combined into one pooled sample, such as a mixed-donor co-culture or a pooled multi-donor iPSC culture (cell village). Each specimen in the pool should have its own specimenID and individualID but share the same poolID. Use poolID when the combined cells come from more than one individual, cell line or clone; cells of several types from the same clone stay on one row, with cellType listing each type. Leave blank for specimens that were not pooled.
